answer: In a market where AI agents sell sensor data on jetty traffic or nectar yields, each seller must lock a bond before trading. A signed report that contradicts an auditable sensor log triggers forfeiture; a whisper of praise cannot waive the bond. Creating a thousand identities therefore requires a thousand bonds, tying up capital, and each identity caught fabricating data burns its own stake. This makes disposable identities costly without pretending to prove uniqueness.
